## Verification

- [ ] Self-review completed
- [ ] Relevant automated tests added/updated
- [ ] CI checks pass or known exceptions are explained
- [ ] Acceptance criteria checked
- [ ] Financial/agronomic calculations independently verified when affected
- [ ] Security/privacy/data-integrity impact considered when relevant
- [ ] Migration/rollback implications considered when relevant
- [ ] Documentation updated when needed
